items.title: Google Antigravity rolls out Remote Agents for cloud-based agentic coding
facts: Antigravity Remote Agents run your agent sessions and tools in an isolated, Google-managed remote environment rather than on your local machine.

Because execution happens remotely, Remote Agents continue working on long-running tasks and executing commands even when you close your browser, put your laptop to sleep, or switch between desktop and mobile devices.
Available to Google AI Pro and Google AI Ultra subscribers signed in with a personal Google Account.

items.title: JetBrains Air ships in 2026.3 IDEs as agentic workbench with free Junie Lite
facts: Air in IDEs is JetBrains’ workspace for coding agents in JetBrains IDEs.
Starting from version 2026.3, the plugin is bundled with JetBrains IDEs.
Junie Lite is free with a JetBrains account.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.319 adds background MCP tasks and permission controls
facts: Added support for MCP tasks in the terminal: when an MCP server runs a tool call as a task, Claude Code moves it to the background right away and tells Claude the result when it finishes.
Added permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting setting: a tool call that would wait on a permission prompt is denied and the turn continues, in terminal sessions, subagents and teammates.
Fixed a sandbox escape when creating a worktree.

items.title: OpenAI recaps Agents API updates including auto review and automations
facts: You can now update the tools in an existing session in the Agents API public beta.
Added automatic review for eligible Agents API projects.
Added scheduled automations to the Agents API public beta.

items.title: Mistral expands Studio with managed agents, workflows and apps
facts: Today, we’re expanding Studio with managed agents and apps, alongside new capabilities for workflows, enterprise context, agent observability and evaluations.
In Studio, developers can now build agents that carry out complex, multi-step tasks.
Developers can equip them with skills that capture the team’s procedures, sandboxes where they can run code, and subagents to delegate parts of a task.
